description: Every PR comes out as chore(deps), which cuts no release: config:recommended's semantic-prefix rule gives fix(deps) only to npm/composer-style depTypes, never pep621's or github-actions'. That rule is resolved after packageRules here, so a semanticCommitType set below would have no effect. With update-lockfile a routine bump touches only uv.lock, which is not in the wheel; retitle a major that moves a pyproject.toml floor by hand if it should release.

packageRules.description: Routine Python bumps ride one grouped PR, merged by GitHub-native auto-merge once the CI Success check that .github/rulesets/protect-main.json requires passes; majors wait for a human. The SonarCloud quality gate is deliberately not required: its conditions cover new code only, which a lock bump never adds. The group is scoped to pep621 here instead of via group:allNonMajor, which would also pull non-major action bumps into it: Renovate resolves that preset's rule after these, so it cannot be overridden from here.
Action pins (SHA plus `# vX` comment, SonarCloud githubactions:S7637) get their own group and never merge themselves, as in the template: a workflow change runs with repository secrets.
